entities.summary: Alfred Ely was a U.S. Representative from New York. He was elected as a Republican to the Thirty-sixth and Thirty-seventh Congresses, serving New York's 29th congressional district. Ely was captured by Confederate forces while spectating at the First Battle of Bull Run.
